text:
glasses_omar: Highly variable. Missed nightstand_b1 (07:07) when it was at bathroom_shelf_ba1. Previous misses included coffee_table_l1 and nightstand_b1. Do not assume it stays in the bedroom. Check bathroom_shelf_ba1, coffee_table_l1, and nightstand_b1.

mug_omar: Erratically moves between kitchen and living room. Missed kitchen_table_k1 (09:13) when it was at coffee_table_l1. Consistent pattern of being at coffee_table_l1 despite assumptions of kitchen locations. Check coffee_table_l1 first, then kitchen_table_k1.

water_bottle_omar: Moves between kitchen and living room. Missed dish_rack_k1 (14:19) when it was at coffee_table_l1. Repeatedly found at coffee_table_l1 despite assumptions of kitchen spots. Check coffee_table_l1 first, then kitchen_table_k1.

charger_omar: Missed desk_b1 (09:55) when it was at coffee_table_l1. Previous misses included bed_b1. It is not always in the bedroom. Check coffee_table_l1, entry_floor_e1, and entry_hook_e1.

book_omar: Missed couch_l1 (10:07) when it was at coffee_table_l1. Previous misses included bed_b1. It is not always on the couch or bed. Check coffee_table_l1 and bed_b1.

glass_omar: New pattern. Missed kitchen_table_k1 (22:59) when it was at cupboard_k1. Unlike other Omar items, this glass was in the kitchen cupboard, not the living room. Check cupboard_k1 and kitchen_table_k1.

General: Coffee_table_l1 remains the most frequent location for Omar’s personal items (mug, water bottle, charger, book, glasses). Do not assume items are in the kitchen, bedroom, or on the desk. Always check coffee_table_l1 first for these specific items. However, note that glass_omar was found in cupboard_k1, so do not apply the coffee_table_l1 rule to all glassware. Avoid assuming fixed locations for mugs, water bottles, or glasses.
